# CLI Reference — `fyr`

This reference documents every `fyr` command, subcommand, and flag. It is generated from `cmd/fyr` flag registrations and help metadata. Run `fyr help <command>` for full terminal help.

## Global Flags

Every `fyr` command accepts these flags before or after the command name. Without `--home`, builds outside `~/.local/bin/fyr` run only `install`, `sync`, `update`, `version`, `list`, `render`, and `diff`.

| Flag | Argument | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--dir` | `DIR` | the project checkout DIR (default working directory) |
| `--help` | — | Print the help page for the command (`-h` alias). |
| `--home` | `DIR` | install under DIR instead of $HOME |
| `--repo` | `DIR` | the harness checkout DIR |
| `-C` | `DIR` | shorthand for --dir DIR |

## Commands

Commands are sorted alphabetically with exact usage and flags.

### `fyr adopt`

Copy a skill from elsewhere into skills/.

> **Caution:** Passing `--force` replaces an existing skill of the same name in `skills/`.

```text
usage: fyr adopt <name|path> [--force] [--json]
```

| Flag | Argument | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `fyr adopt --force` | — | replace a skill of the same name already in skills/ |
| `fyr adopt --json` | — | print the result as JSON |

### `fyr auto`

Idle-time runs: on, off, status, run, log, sim.

> **Caution:** Passing `--force` to `fyr auto run` bypasses the 4-hour model-run cooldown.

```text
usage: fyr auto on [--conversation-idle D] [--dry-run] [--json]
       fyr auto off [--dry-run] [--json]
       fyr auto status [--json]
       fyr auto run [--force] [--dry-run] [--json]
       fyr auto log [--lines N | --limit N | --all] [--json]
       fyr auto sim <list|show|record|merge> [flags]
       fyr auto --dry-run [--json]
```

#### `fyr auto log`

| Flag | Argument | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `fyr auto log --all` | — | log: print every line of auto.log |
| `fyr auto log --json` | — | print the result as JSON |
| `fyr auto log --limit` | `N` | log: alias for --lines, print the last N lines of auto.log |
| `fyr auto log --lines` | `N` | log: print the last N lines of auto.log (default 50) |

#### `fyr auto off`

|---|---|---|

#### `fyr auto sim`

Manage the global Self-Improvement Memory (SIM) ledger in `brain.db`.

```text
usage: fyr auto sim list [--signal SIG] [--path PREFIX] [--status S]
                         [--limit N] [--json]
       fyr auto sim show <SIM-ID> [--json]
       fyr auto sim record --what TEXT (--problem ID | --root-cause TEXT)
                           [--mechanism M] [--status S] [--signal SIG]
                           [--files CSV] [--proposal ID] [--commit SHA]
                           [--parent SHA] [--harness VER]
                           [--proposer-model ID] [--policy-model ID]
                           [--source K] [--verdict V] [--field-status S]
                           [--predicted-rows CSV] [--predicted-signals CSV]
                           [--fixed-rows CSV] [--missed-rows CSV]
                           [--regressed-rows CSV] [--provenance P]
                           [--json-in] [--json]
       fyr auto sim merge <OLD-ID> <TARGET-ID> [--provenance P] [--json]
```

### `fyr eval`

Run behavioural rows against the CLI.

```text
usage: fyr eval --home DIR [--fixture DIR] [--suite-file PATH] [--runs N]
                [--parallel N] [--model ID] [--acp] [--runner R]
                [--json] <row>...
       fyr eval [--suite-file PATH] --list [--json]
```

| Flag | Argument | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `fyr eval --acp` | — | drive trials via agy acp --stdio --process-per-session |
| `fyr eval --fixture` | `DIR` | the git repository DIR each row clones (default: this checkout) |
| `fyr eval --json` | — | print the result as JSON |
| `fyr eval --list` | — | print the suite's rows (id, agent or -, named or wide, version, kind) and run nothing |
| `fyr eval --model` | `ID` | pass --model ID to agy for each trial (default: agy default) |
| `fyr eval --parallel` | `N` | run up to N trials at once, 1 to 25 (default 1; benchmark trials stay at 1) |
| `fyr eval --runner` | `R` | where each trial's session runs: R is isolate (default isolate) |
| `fyr eval --runs` | `N` | run each named row N times, 1 to 25, each trial in its own sandbox |
| `fyr eval --suite-file` | `PATH` | read the suite from PATH outside every checkout; labels rows eval=holdout/<id> |

### `fyr graph`

Interactive AST and telemetry constellation.

> **Caution:** Passing `--force` overwrites an existing output file.

```text
usage: fyr graph [--out FILE] [--force] [--include-tests] [--include-docs]
                 [--include-vendored]
       fyr graph (--dot | --md | --json) [--out FILE] [--force]
                 [--include-tests] [--include-docs] [--include-vendored]
       fyr graph --web [--listen ADDR] [--include-tests] [--include-docs]
                 [--include-vendored]
```

| Flag | Argument | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `fyr graph --dot` | — | write Graphviz DOT instead of HTML (stdout unless --out) |
| `fyr graph --force` | — | overwrite an existing output file |
| `fyr graph --include-docs` | — | include Markdown files and doc headings in the graph |
| `fyr graph --include-tests` | — | include test files, test packages and test edges |
| `fyr graph --include-vendored` | — | include vendored skill references and assets in the graph |
| `fyr graph --json` | — | write the graph payload as JSON (stdout unless --out) |
| `fyr graph --listen` | `ADDR` | with --web, bind ADDR instead of 127.0.0.1:0 |
| `fyr graph --md` | — | write the Markdown architecture summary (stdout unless --out) |
| `fyr graph --out` | `FILE` | write output to FILE (default .agents/scratch/graph.html for HTML) |
| `fyr graph --web` | — | serve the rendered graph in memory on 127.0.0.1:0 in the foreground |

### `fyr help`

Print the short command list or one command help page.

```text
usage: fyr help [<command>]
```

This command takes only global flags.

### `fyr index`

Reconcile the search index; --register opts in.

```text
usage: fyr index [--global] [--rebuild] [--json]
       fyr index --register [--rebuild] [--json]
```

| Flag | Argument | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `fyr index --global` | — | the global search index, ~/.config/fyr/search.db, instead of this checkout's |
| `fyr index --json` | — | print the result as JSON |
| `fyr index --rebuild` | — | delete the index and build it again |
| `fyr index --register` | — | register this checkout (the operator's consent, ADR-068) so cross-project readers take it (fyr search --global, fyr record import --global, and the metrics attribution join) once it has records in brain.db or .agents/trail.jsonl, then index it |

### `fyr metrics`

```text

       fyr metrics show [--since YYYY-MM-DD | --since-tag TAG]

                          [--until YYYY-MM-DD] [--project [DIR] | --global]
                          [--md | --json | --daily-digest [--json]]
                          [--web [--listen ADDR]] [--include-sandboxes]
                          [--label KEY=VALUE | --all-labels]
                          [--context-target N] [--no-ingest] [--out FILE]
       fyr metrics evals [--since YYYY-MM-DD] [--until YYYY-MM-DD]
                         [--harness KEY] [--json]

                              [--json]
```

| `fyr metrics show --until` | `YYYY-MM-DD` | show, report, evals: the window's end, YYYY-MM-DD, exclusive (default now) |

#### `fyr metrics trajectory`

| Flag | Argument | Description |
|---|---|---|

### `fyr models`

The live agy model catalog and role picks.

```text
usage: fyr models [--explain [ID]] [--json] [--pick ROLE [--tier T]
                  [--caller-family FAM]] [--refresh]
       fyr models --bench [--model ID] [--max N] [--refresh] [--json]
```

| Flag | Argument | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `fyr models --bench` | — | probe up to --max 0-run active models and record kind=bench trials |
| `fyr models --caller-family` | `FAMILY` | with --pick: caller FAMILY (gemini, anthropic or other) |
| `fyr models --explain` | `ID` | print profile, score breakdown, and empirical stats for model ID (or all if omitted) |
| `fyr models --json` | — | print the catalog, --pick, --explain or --bench result as JSON |
| `fyr models --max` | `N` | with --bench: probe at most N 0-run active models (default 3) |
| `fyr models --model` | `ID` | with --bench: probe only the active non-interactive model ID |
| `fyr models --pick` | `ROLE` | pick one model for ROLE (builder, planner, judge, security, ...) |
| `fyr models --refresh` | — | re-query agy models and update .config/fyr/models.json |
| `fyr models --tier` | `T` | with --pick: the tier T, pro, flash or light |

### `fyr record`

Add, get, edit, list or import trail records.

```text
usage: fyr record add <kind> [--title T | --title-file FILE] [--status S]
                      [--id ID] [--body-file FILE | --json-in]
                      [--global [--project ROOT]]
       fyr record get <id>... [--out FILE | --json] [--global]
       fyr record edit <id> [--status S] [--title T]
                       [--body | --body-file FILE | --json-in] [--global]
       fyr record list [--kind K] [--open] [--limit N] [--json]
                       [--global [--project ROOT]] [--all]
       fyr record export
       fyr record sync
       fyr record import [--dry-run] [<docs-root>]
       fyr record import --global [--dry-run]
```

| `fyr record add --json-in` | — | add, edit: read JSON payload from stdin |
| `fyr record add --project` | `ROOT` | add, list with --global: the project ROOT a global record is about |

| `fyr record add --title` | `T` | add, edit: the record's one-line title, T |

### `fyr report`

Project or global usage report (HTML, --md, --json, --web).

```text
usage: fyr report [--project [DIR] | --global] [--md | --json] [--out FILE]
                  [--daily-digest [--json]] [--web [--listen ADDR]]
                  [--include-sandboxes] [--since YYYY-MM-DD | --since-tag TAG]
                  [--until YYYY-MM-DD] [--label KEY=VALUE | --all-labels]
                  [--context-target N] [--no-ingest]
```

<details>
<summary>Flags (16)</summary>

| Flag | Argument | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `fyr report --all-labels` | — | include labelled (sandbox) sessions |
| `fyr report --context-target` | `N` | the peak context, N tokens, a main session should stay under (default 300000) |
| `fyr report --daily-digest` | — | compute, store and print today's daily health digest |
| `fyr report --global` | — | all projects across the local store |
| `fyr report --include-sandboxes` | — | include ephemeral eval, smoke, probe and scratch roots |
| `fyr report --json` | — | write JSON instead of HTML (stdout unless --out) |
| `fyr report --label` | `KEY=VALUE` | only sessions with KEY=VALUE |
| `fyr report --listen` | `ADDR` | with --web, bind ADDR instead of 127.0.0.1:0 |
| `fyr report --md` | — | write Markdown instead of HTML (stdout unless --out) |
| `fyr report --no-ingest` | — | skip incremental metrics ingest before rendering |
| `fyr report --out` | `FILE` | the output file FILE (default ~/.config/fyr/reports/<date-time>-metrics.html) |
| `fyr report --project` | `DIR` | only sessions in the project DIR (bare --project uses this checkout) |
| `fyr report --since` | `YYYY-MM-DD` | the window's start, YYYY-MM-DD (default 30 days ago) |
| `fyr report --since-tag` | `TAG` | window start at git tag TAG |
| `fyr report --until` | `YYYY-MM-DD` | the window's end, YYYY-MM-DD, exclusive (default now) |
| `fyr report --web` | — | serve the rendered report in memory on 127.0.0.1:0 in the foreground |

</details>

### `fyr search`

Ranked search of records and files.

```text
usage: fyr search [--limit N] [--kind K] [--global] [--json] <words>...
       fyr search --refs <BUG-NNN|ADR-NNN|path> [--kind K] [--global]
       fyr search --open [--kind K] [--global]
       fyr search --slice QUERY [--hops N] [--budget N] [--session ID]
                  [--include-docs]
       fyr search --contracts TARGET [--budget N] [--json]
       fyr search --skeleton FILE
       fyr search --path SYM [--to SYM]
       fyr search --affected TARGET
       fyr search --map [--include-docs]
       fyr search --vet PROMPT
       fyr search --hook <session-start|pre-invocation|pre-tool-use|
                          post-tool-use|stop>
```

<details>
<summary>Flags (19)</summary>

| Flag | Argument | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `fyr search --affected` | `TARGET` | reverse-BFS blast radius (<= 2 hops) for TARGET path or symbol |
| `fyr search --budget` | `N` | slice, contracts: token budget N estimated as chars/4 (default 2000; 1500 for --contracts) |
| `fyr search --contracts` | `TARGET` | deterministic AST signatures, linked SPEC-* contracts and ADR guardrails for TARGET |
| `fyr search --global` | — | also the global records and every project registered with index --register, from the brain store |
| `fyr search --hook` | `EVENT` | Antigravity lifecycle hook EVENT: session-start, pre-invocation, pre-tool-use, post-tool-use or stop |
| `fyr search --hops` | `N` | slice: maximum graph hops N, 0-6 (default 2) |
| `fyr search --include-docs` | — | include Markdown docs and headings in AST maps and slices |
| `fyr search --json` | — | print hits or query results as JSON |
| `fyr search --kind` | `K` | only hits of kind K: bug adr plan change handoff review testing retro spec deploy trail code doc feedback proposal learning guide memory |
| `fyr search --limit` | `N` | print at most N records and as many files, 1-50 (default 10) |
| `fyr search --map` | — | top-10 God Nodes by PageRank, package deps and cycle check |
| `fyr search --open` | — | open bugs, plans with unticked boxes, and the other open records |
| `fyr search --path` | `SYM` | shortest call/type/interface path from SYM (<= 6 hops) |
| `fyr search --refs` | `REF` | every record naming REF: an ID, a file, or a directory (trailing /) |
| `fyr search --session` | `ID` | slice: conversation ID whose read files get the 50x boost |
| `fyr search --skeleton` | `FILE` | declaration-only start-end signature lines for FILE |
| `fyr search --slice` | `QUERY` | 0/1/2-hop context capsule for QUERY ranked by PageRank |
| `fyr search --to` | `SYM` | path: target symbol SYM (or give as positional argument) |
| `fyr search --vet` | `PROMPT` | 9-mode intent, 6-anchor vetter and skill/record match for PROMPT |

</details>
